tools.name: merchant360_check_key
tools.description: Show the merchant the API key acts on, the key's name, its scopes and whether it is live or test. Use it first to confirm the connection. Merchant360 API: GET /me.

tools.name: merchant360_list_staff
tools.description: List the staff roster (name, title, sort order, whether the person has a login). This list is read-only and not paginated. Shift workers use the roster key from merchant360_list_shifts. Merchant360 API: GET /staff.

tools.name: merchant360_list_shifts
tools.description: List team shifts that start in a window, draft and published, earliest first, with the roster of people who can be scheduled (roster[].key is the worker_key to use when writing a shift). Not paginated. The default window starts at Sunday midnight of the current week (server time zone) and lasts 14 d

tools.name: merchant360_get_shift
tools.description: Get one shift by id: worker, start and end, unpaid break, role, note, and whether it is a draft or published. Merchant360 API: GET /shifts/{id}.

tools.name: merchant360_list_schedule_requests
tools.description: List staff time-off requests and shift trade requests (drop, pickup, handoff), newest first. Filter by status when set. Not paginated. Old requests are left out by the vendor. Merchant360 API: GET /schedule-requests.

tools.name: merchant360_create_shift
tools.description: WRITE: create a DRAFT shift. Staff do not see it and no text is sent until merchant360_publish_shifts publishes its window. Omit worker_key for an open shift. A shift lasts at most 24 hours. Merchant360 API: POST /shifts.

tools.name: merchant360_update_shift
tools.description: WRITE: change one shift. Fields you omit keep their value. Send worker_key null to make the shift open, and role or note null (or empty) to clear them. A published shift shows the change to staff only after merchant360_publish_shifts runs again. Merchant360 API: PATCH /shifts/{id}.

tools.name: merchant360_delete_shift
tools.description: WRITE: permanently delete one shift, draft or published. No text is sent. A deleted published shift leaves the staff schedule at the next publish. Merchant360 API: DELETE /shifts/{id}.

tools.name: merchant360_publish_shifts
tools.description: WRITE: publish every DRAFT shift that starts in the window, so staff can see it. Each worker with a published shift and a mobile number gets a text with a link to their schedule. Publishing an already-published window publishes nothing new. Merchant360 API: POST /shifts/publish.

tools.name: merchant360_decide_schedule_request
tools.description: WRITE: approve or deny one staff time-off or shift trade request. The worker is texted the outcome, with the note when given. Approved time off also blocks those days on the public booking calendar. A decided request returns 409. Merchant360 API: POST /schedule-requests/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: merchant360_create_shift · Private data: merchant360_check_key · Public sink: merchant360_create_shift, merchant360_update_shift, merchant360_delete_shift, merchant360_publish_shifts, merchant360_decide_schedule_request · Destructive: merchant360_list_schedule_requests, merchant360_delete_shift.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: merchant360_create_shift · Private data: merchant360_check_key · Public sink: merchant360_create_shift, merchant360_update_shift, merchant360_delete_shift, merchant360_publish_shifts, merchant360_decide_schedule_request · Destructive: merchant360_list_schedule_requests, merchant360_delete_shift

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
